covers.desc: Be able to describe the properties of the t-distribution, determine degrees of freedom, verify conditions for inference about a mean, and recognize matched-pairs data.
Be able to construct and interpret a confidence interval for a population mean, including the mean of matched-pairs differences.
Be able to conduct and interpret a significance test for a population mean, including matched-pairs differences.
Be able to construct a confidence interval and conduct a significance test for the difference between two independent population means.
